title: 같은 네트워크
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop synth-pop track in G Major at 118 BPM. The arrangement features a prominent slap bass line that syncopates with a punchy kick drum and crisp snare. Bright, polyphonic synth pads provide harmonic texture while a staccato synth lead plays rhythmic accents. Clean electric guitar funk-style scratches appear in the background. The male vocals are processed with light compression and subtle doubling, shifting between a rhythmic chest voice and smooth falsetto in the higher register. The production uses gated reverb on the snare and stereo-widened synth sweeps during transitions.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[slap bass, electronic drums, bright synth pads]

오늘 일이 전부 무거워 말풍선 안에 쏟아부었어
